display_name: Radars of the regiment's control battery that feed the PU-12M
status: Library of radar TYPES (simcore/c2_sources.hpp, roadmap 7.1). A scenario's "c2.regiment" block places instances of them; the PU-12M's board then only holds the targets some radar of the list covers. Every number cited; both radars' heights are estimates.
notes: Coverage is the simplest honest model: a target is seen when it is within the radar's range and above its radar horizon, 4.12 (sqrt(antenna height) + sqrt(target height)) km. No clutter, terrain or blind cone; that is the EM layer's job.

radars.notes: The control battery's radar in the Soviet regiment (korovin_tiv_2010) and two of the NVA regiment's (flak11).

max_range_m.source: fm100_2_3 p. 5-138 (Flat Face, UHF, 250 km: the US Army's view in 1991); nato_radar_refs (P-19 instrumented range 260 km)

antenna_height_m.source: estimate (a truck- or trailer-mounted UHF early-warning antenna stands a few metres up)

radars.notes: In the NVA regiment's headquarters battery (flak11).

max_range_m.source: fm100_2_3 p. 5-138 (Long Track, over 150 km: a lower bound)
